prs.title: fix: propagate SSE stream errors to waiting requests
prs.author: heyhayes
prs.cluster_pick_reason: Both PRs address silent error loss, but they solve different layers of the problem. PR #2374 adds logging to the message_handler — exceptions become visible in logs but are still swallowed, so callers waiting for a response never receive an error signal. PR #2122 propagates SSE stream errors to waiting requests, which is the behavioral fix the issue requires: code blocking on a response actually gets an error rather than hanging or receiving nothing. Propagation is a superset of logging — if errors reach callers, they can also be logged there. Going the other direction (logging only) leaves the broken contract intact. PR #2122 is also the older submission (lower PR number) and the tiebreaker on "oldest" further supports it. The 3-vs-2 file difference is minor and does not outweigh the correctness advantage.

clusters.pick_reason: Both PRs address silent error loss, but they solve different layers of the problem. PR #2374 adds logging to the message_handler — exceptions become visible in logs but are still swallowed, so callers waiting for a response never receive an error signal. PR #2122 propagates SSE stream errors to waiting requests, which is the behavioral fix the issue requires: code blocking on a response actually gets an error rather than hanging or receiving nothing. Propagation is a superset of logging — if errors reach callers, they can also be logged there. Going the other direction (logging only) leaves the broken contract intact. PR #2122 is also the older submission (lower PR number) and the tiebreaker on "oldest" further supports it. The 3-vs-2 file difference is minor and does not outweigh the correctness advantage.
